acceptance: A width increase over the measured capacity is refused with the measure named, through the real policy entry point.
A fixture of wave 185 data fails the check at width 8 and a fixture of wave 184 data passes it at width 5.
The enforce flip of the host window at 12 lanes names the check in its precondition.
fix: Design review first. Define a capacity record: lock wait for each window, heavy-run time for each cycle and the audit tier timeouts, measured at the current width. A width increase, and the flip of the host window from shadow to enforce at 12, need a record that passes bounds in policy. The check is a verb that refuses with the measure named.
summary: The width rose from 4 to 8 on 2026-11-14 with no measure of how many heavy verification runs the host carries. At 8 lanes the lock and the lane budget stacked and wave 185 shipped 0 of 9. The operator wants 12 lanes with a host-adaptive window, shadow first. The window reads CPU, memory and swap, and does not read lock wait.
title: A fleet width increase passes a verification capacity check, and fleet-12 enforce needs it
